items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: That was Doc Cheatham and Mario and the saxophone was Johnny Nieto, Freddy Skerrittand Pin Madera.

ctx.x: Okay. When you and Mario got together, who were your trumpet players then?
That was Doc Cheatham and Mario and the saxophone was Johnny Nieto, Freddy Skerrittand Pin Madera.
Okay, later on came Bobby Woodlen, right?
